page_title: AI Gateway for Production LLM Routing | Respan

sources.entry: Respan - Full-stack AI engineering platform for tracing, evals, prompt management, and a gateway to 250+ models. #freemium

summary.name: Respan AI Gateway
summary.one_liner: A hosted AI gateway that exposes 1,000+ models behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with failover, response caching, spend limits, and request logging.
use_cases: Route LLM requests to many providers through one endpoint
Fall back to another model when a provider errors or rate-limits
Cache repeated prompts to cut cost and latency
Set per-customer or org-wide spend and rate limits
Track usage and cost per customer, feature, or environment
Debug production LLM calls with logged metadata
summary.what_it_does: Respan's gateway lets you point an existing SDK (the page shows the OpenAI Python client) at one endpoint and reach 1,000+ models, either through a unified router or a provider passthrough URL. You switch models by changing the model slug. Requests can specify fallback models that are tried when the primary errors or rate-limits. Response caching can be enabled per request to serve repeated calls from cache. Budgets and rate limits can be set per key, per customer, or org-wide, with warnings as spend nears a limit and blocking once it passes. Every request is logged with metadata such as customer identifier, feature, and environment.
notable: One endpoint for 1,000+ models with OpenAI-compatible SDK usage
Automatic fallback models plus per-request response caching
Budgets and rate limits per key, customer, or org with warn and block behavior
Built-in observability and evals alongside the gateway
caveats: Pricing tiers are not stated on the page; the freemium label comes from the directory listing
Compliance claims (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA with BAA available) are listed on the page without detail on scope
